Additionally, the sources mention the importance of edge computing and real-time data processing, as well as the ongoing rivalry between AWS and Azure in the enterprise AI space. The sources also note the increasing adoption of multicloud interconnects, with AWS and Azure leading in this domain.

searches.answer: Kubernetes 1.20 announced the removal of Docker runtime support in future releases, with the latest plan to remove it in version 1.22. This change is due to Docker runtime's non-compliance with the Container Runtime Interface (CRI) for Kubernetes. Kubernetes platforms like Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Red Hat OpenShift have already moved to default to other container runtimes such as containerd or CRI-O. Users running their own clusters need to switch to compliant container runtimes like containerd or CRI-O to avoid disruptions.
